patterns.note: Asymmetrical arrangements of illustrative elements (abstract shapes, product mockups) that often float or break out of content containers, creating a dynamic and less rigid visual structure.
A clear hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings for impact, complemented by a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, and occasional smaller uppercase labels for emphasis.

A high-contrast dark background (#0d0c0e) paired with a vibrant, pastel-like accent palette (#e6c0ff, #faed99, #cce2fc, #71a641) used for illustrative elements and occasional light section backgrounds.
Scroll-triggered parallax and independent movement of illustrative 3D-ish elements in the hero section, creating a multi-layered depth effect as the user scrolls.
Content sections reveal with a subtle slide-up or fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by a transformation of internal elements like a progress slider.
Alternating full-bleed dark background sections with full-bleed light background sections, creating clear visual breaks and varying the page's rhythm.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex scroll-based animations. Illustrative elements (abstract shapes, product cards) in the hero section are animated with independent parallax and subtle rotations as the user scrolls, creating a multi-layered depth effect. Subsequent content sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport.
Combines a minimalist dark background with vibrant, soft-gradient abstract 3D shapes and product mockups, giving a playful yet sophisticated aesthetic.
Key data points are presented within translucent, dark-themed cards that overlap and create a sense of depth, enhancing visual interest for statistics.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, readable sans-serif body text, and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (4-8px) on interactive elements and card corners, while abstract shapes incorporate both rounded and circular forms.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around content blocks, creating a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The distinctive use of animated, floating, abstract 3D-ish shapes and product mockups against a dark, spacious background creates a playful yet sophisticated and modern aesthetic. The translucent, overlapping data cards also provide a unique way to display information.
